mapper.sql: SELECT id, username, name, local_id, server_id, type, sender, content, quote, quote_kind, media_path, create_time, sort_seq, md5, msg_category, category_source, category_reason, status, relat_inq, relat_offer, entry_fail_count, entry_status, entry_message, entry_offer_count, entry_offer_ids, entry_at FROM wechat_message
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wechat_message (username, name, local_id, server_id, type, sender, content, quote, quote_kind, media_path, create_time, sort_seq, md5, msg_category, category_source, category_reason, status, relat_inq, relat_offer, entry_fail_count) VALUES
(#{m.username}, #{m.name}, #{m.localId}, #{m.serverId}, #{m.type}, #{m.sender}, #{m.content}, #{m.quote}, #{m.quoteKind}, #{m.mediaPath}, #{m.createTime}, #{m.sortSeq}, #{m.md5}, #{m.msgCategory}, #{m.categorySource}, #{m.categoryReason}, COALESCE(#{m.status}, 0), #{m.relatInq}, #{m.relatOffer}, COALESCE(#{m.entryFailCount}, 0))
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE username = VALUES(username)
mapper.update: UPDATE wechat_message SET msg_category = #{m.msgCategory}, category_source = #{m.categorySource}, category_reason = #{m.categoryReason}, relat_inq = #{m.relatInq}, relat_offer = #{m.relatOffer}, status = 1, entry_status = CASE WHEN #{m.msgCategory} IN ('INQ','OFFER') AND (entry_status IS NULL OR entry_status = 'NOT_APPLICABLE') THEN 'PENDING' WHEN #{m.msgCategory} NOT IN ('INQ','OFFER') AND entry_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE' ELSE entry_status END, entry_at = CASE WHEN #{m.msgCategory} IN ('INQ','OFFER') AND (entry_status IS NULL OR entry_status = 'NOT_APPLICABLE') THEN NOW() WHEN #{m.msgCategory} IN ('INQ','OFFER') AND entry_at IS NULL THEN NOW() ELSE entry_at END WHERE username = #{m.username} AND local_id = #{m.localId}

UPDATE wechat_message SET msg_category = 'OTHER', category_source = 'FILTER', category_reason = #{reason}, relat_inq = '', relat_offer = '', status = 3, entry_status = 'NOT_APPLICABLE' WHERE username = #{m.username} AND local_id = #{m.localId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wechat_message_black (username, name, local_id, server_id, type, sender, content, quote, quote_kind, media_path, create_time, sort_seq, md5) VALUES
(#{m.username}, #{m.name}, #{m.localId}, #{m.serverId}, #{m.type}, #{m.sender}, #{m.content}, #{m.quote}, #{m.quoteKind}, #{m.mediaPath}, #{m.createTime}, #{m.sortSeq}, #{m.md5})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE username = VALUES(username)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(create_time) AS earliest FROM wechat_message WHERE status = 0

SELECT entry_status AS entryStatus, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(create_time) AS earliest FROM wechat_message WHERE msg_category IN ('INQ','OFFER') AND create_time >= #{since} GROUP BY entry_status ORDER BY entry_status
mapper.update: UPDATE wechat_message SET entry_status = 'PROCESSING', entry_message = 'AI录入处理中', entry_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username} AND local_id = #{localId} AND status = 1 AND (entry_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') OR (entry_status = 'PROCESSING' AND entry_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)))

UPDATE wechat_message SET status = #{messageStatus}, entry_status = #{entryStatus}, entry_message = #{entryMessage}, entry_offer_count = #{offerCount}, entry_offer_ids = #{offerIds}, entry_fail_count = #{failCount}, entry_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username} AND local_id = #{localId}

UPDATE wechat_message SET entry_status = 'PENDING', entry_message = '人工重新入队', entry_fail_count = 0, status = 1, entry_at = NOW() WHERE status IN (1,3) AND msg_category IN ('INQ','OFFER') AND entry_status IN ('SKIPPED','FAILED','DEAD') AND name = #{chat}
